\begin{tablenotes}
\small
\item \textit{Notes:} Means over \(9\) independent draws of \(N=100{,}000\) from
the aligned design of Appendix~\ref{dgp}, with across-draw standard deviations
in parentheses. The design has \(\beta=2\), \(b=\delta_0=1\), \(k=-1\) and
\(\operatorname{plim}\widehat\beta_{\mathrm{OLS}}=3\); the orthogonality point is
\(\delta^\star\) in Table~\ref{tab:fgls}. The error variance is scaled by
\(h(\cdot)=\{0.3+\exp(\theta\,\cdot)\}^{1/2}\), evaluated at the standardized
control \(w\) in the middle block and at the regressor \(x\) in the last;
\(\theta=0\) is the homoscedastic baseline. In every row the marginal alignment
restriction \(\mu_{03}=b\,\mu_{30}\) is re-imposed by resolving for the skewness
of the exogenous error, so the comparison isolates the mixed-moment channel.
\(\widehat\delta_0\) is the root of the DT moment; \(\widetilde\delta_0\) is the
root of the same polynomial \eqref{eq:M_third_moments} with \(\widehat\mu_{21}\)
and \(\widehat\mu_{12}\) set to zero (Remark~\ref{rem:mixed_sensitivity}). The
marginal moments are constant across rows at \(\widehat\mu_{30}=-0.351\) and
\(\widehat\mu_{03}=-0.348\); the other mixed moment is \(\widehat\mu_{21}=-0.000\)
throughout.
\end{tablenotes}
